complete_examples.text: The vertical force between wheel and rail that cou-ples the vehicle and track subsystems can be calculated according to the Hertz nonlinear elastic contact theory.23 The dynamic equations of the vehicle–FST coupled system can be solved by a fast explicit integration method proposed by Zhai25 This integration method takes the use of displacement, velocity and acceleration in previous two steps to predict the displacement and velocity of next step, then compute the next step acceleration through the system dynamic equations.
